description: This is a Kotlin source file containing unit tests for the NextcloudBackend class, which is part of a synchronization module for notes using Nextcloud API. The tests verify network availability checks, caching behavior based on a time expiration, and interactions with mocked API interfaces.

classes.name: NextcloudBackendTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the NextcloudBackend class, focusing on network availability status, caching, and API interaction verification.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mocks and sets up the test environment before each test.

methods.name: isAvailable fetches from API on first call
methods.description: Tests that the 'isAvailable' method fetches capabilities from the API on the first invocation and verifies the returned status.

methods.name: isAvailable returns cached value within expiration period
methods.description: Verifies that the 'isAvailable' method uses cached data when called within the cache expiration period.

methods.name: isAvailable refetches after expiration period
methods.description: Ensures that 'isAvailable' triggers a fresh API call after the cache expiration time has passed.
